acceptance: Tuning-file partitioning and sorting map to hypertable and compression settings; the precedence between CLI flags and the tuning file is documented
Each request is verified against the timescaledb_information catalog, or recorded as not applied with a reason
Live TPC-H SF0.01 tuned run, with the evidence recorded in the PR
Platform docs page describes the method
context: Owner request 2026-10-17: "There should be a method for tuning these platforms."
description: TimescaleDB skips tuning-file partitioning (benchbox/platforms/timescaledb.py:50). Its native layout controls are reachable only through CLI flags: --timescale-chunk-interval and --timescale-compression (timescaledb.py:73-97). Map the tuning file onto them: a date partition column becomes the hypertable time column, sort columns become compress_orderby, and segment columns become compress_segmentby. Also keep CLUSTER, which was confirmed working on a hypertable during the #3092 verification. Record each request in the ledger with catalog evidence (timescaledb_information views).
